g.text: To put in the template as a use case?

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: We have an RA A which can be applied after contingency C if condition D at timephase T is met and if condition D after contingency C at

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: timephase T is met, then I wil aplly the RA for any timephase whose reference time is larger or equal than the RA time to implement.

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: We have at time zero something happens. This is the first timpehase. Then we have a timephase of evaluation of condition D which is the

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: timephase T. In this one we are not apllying any RA. Then we have any further timephase and wer will aplly the RA only in those timephases

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: which are after the time to implement.

g.text: Wha tis Constrint combination of one a quantity on the system. THis we have freedom. . Then there is a limit (This specific wauntity has to eb

g.text: within a bound). There is a time eleement. You have to say for which time this constraint myst be respected. On top of that we have the creiteria
